# Italy

Region: Europe. Sources verified 2026-10-11. Scope follows source documentation, not assumed nationwide CAMT availability.

## Country / regional references

### CBI S.c.p.a.

**Role:** Italian interbank corporate-banking service and technical-standard maintainer

**Reporting coverage:** Cash-management and information flows are in scope, but exact CAMT 052/053/054 namespace coverage and current CBI XML versions are not publicly verified.

**Messages / versions:** ISO20022 (general; exact reporting message identifiers not publicly verified); CBI-specific payment and information formats

- [Servizio CBI scope and access requirements](https://www.cbi-org.eu/Servizio-CBI) — availability; public-page
- [CBI standards portal](https://www.cbi-org.eu/Standard) — portal; registration
- [Official free-registration standard-download announcement](https://www.cbi-org.eu/News/A-disposizione-la-versione-inglese-degli-Standard-del-Servizio-CBI) — availability; public-page

Official announcement states standards align with ISO 20022/Berlin Group and are downloadable free after registration. Do not relabel CBIDlyStmtReqLogMsg or CBIPrdcStmtReqLogMsg as raw camt 053 without inspecting their schemas. Third-party legacy CBI-RND 001 mirrors excluded; no account created.
